answer.justification: Chronic high-dose acetaminophen and aspirin cause analgesic nephropathy, predisposing to renal papillary necrosis. Typical features include hematuria, colicky flank pain, and proteinuria; sloughed papillae may cause obstruction. The absence of fever, palpable mass, or recurrent stone history argues against pyelonephritis, mass, or nephrolithiasis.
